note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are an online homeware retailer. We handle 3,000 returns a month by email, and each email return costs us about $6 in agent time.

answers.common.decision: Whether to build a self-service returns flow and what it must do; the head of customer service decides.
answers.common.audience: The head of customer service and our one developer.
answers.common.materials: Customers often forget to include the order details or a reason, so agents email back.
answers.consulting.current-state: We tried a returns form on the website last year, but it only collected order numbers. Last month 540 returns needed a second email to the customer.
answers.consulting.success: Cut agent cost on returns by 60% and keep second emails under 5% of returns.
answers.consulting.constraints: One developer for three months; it must work with our existing order system.
